recs.stt: Are you an anarchist? The answer may surprise you (2000)
recs.x:
Funnily enough, as an anarchist, I never heard before that removing the government (or hierarchical use of violence) would remove violence from the world.

There are plenty of ideas on how to keep law and order in an anarchic society.
I recommend you to read The Machinery of Freedom (by David Friedman) or check out a summary here: [link]
